## Attendance

The programme board met in October 2022. Present were J. Whitfield, S. Rahman, Priya Anand, R. Adeyemi, G. Evans. J. Whitfield chaired the meeting. Attendance was confirmed at the start of the meeting, and no apologies or changes to membership were recorded.

## Performance

The board reviewed activity and the current position against the programme’s operational measures. There were 2149 captures during October 2022. The backlog was reported as 205. Letter breaches remained at 1. The board noted these figures and agreed that performance would continue to be monitored through routine reporting.

No further performance issues were raised for discussion. Members were asked to maintain oversight of the backlog and letter position and to bring any material change to the board’s attention through the usual reporting arrangements.

## Items

The board considered routine business only. No additional items were recorded, and there were no matters requiring escalation or a separate decision. The discussion remained focused on the activity position and the reported backlog and letter figures.

## Actions

Actions carried forward to the next meeting. Members will continue to monitor the reported position, including captures, the backlog and letter breaches, and provide an update through the established programme reporting process. No new action owner or deadline was recorded in the minutes.
